description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the Employee entity within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It contains test cases that verify the behavior of Employee objects, particularly focusing on entity persistence, relationships with the Nationality entity, and string trimming for employee names.

classes.name: EmployeeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the Employee entity in the OrangeHRM system, testing entity persistence, related nationality data, and string manipulation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables before each test execution.

methods.name: testEmployeeEntityWithNationality
methods.description: Tests creating an Employee, assigning a Nationality, persisting, and verifying the data including the nationality relationship.

methods.name: testEmployeeDetailsTrim
methods.description: Tests that employee name fields are properly trimmed and concatenated to produce a full name.
